title: Fourier degree after mean subtraction
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$, and let $k$ be a natural number. If the Fourier degree of $f$ is at most $k$, then the Fourier degree of $x\mapsto f(x)-\mathbb{E}[f]$, where the expectation is uniform on the sign cube, is at most $k$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
